description.zh: 用户应用在链路数据里记录的名称。完全匹配。
description.en: Name of the user application recorded in the trace data. Exact match.

description.zh: 搜索关键字。会在任务名称、任务id、任务描述这些字段上模糊匹配。
description.en: Search keyword. It will match on fields such as task name, application name (appName), task description, and evaluation metric name.

description.zh: 搜索时间范围的UTC截止时间
description.en: The UTC end time of the search time range

description.zh: 搜索时间范围的UTC开始时间
description.en: The UTC start time of the search time range

description.zh: 当前页数。取值范围：大于0的整数。默认值：1。
description.en: The current page number. Value range: integers greater than 0. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页大小，默认为10，最大为50。
任务数据采样方式。窗口或者概率。精确匹配。
description.en: Sampling method for job data. Valid values are window or probability. Exact match.

description.zh: 用于排序返回结果的字段，目前支持TaskId, CreateTime，TaskName，和Status。不填则默认用CreateTime
description.en: Field used to sort the return result. Supported fields: TaskId, CreateTime, TaskName, and Status. If not specified, results are sorted by CreateTime by default.

description.zh: 返回结果的排序方向。取值范围：ASC（升序）、DESC（降序）。不填则默认用DESC。
description.en: Sort order of the return result. Valid values: ASC (ascending) or DESC (descending). If not specified, results are sorted in descending order by default.

title.zh: 获取链路评估任务列表。
title.en: Retrieve the list of link assessment tasks.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun paillmtrace list-online-eval-tasks --min-time 2025-04-05_13:24:25_2025-04-05 --max-time 2025-04-07_13:24:25_2025-04-07 --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --app-name my-foo-llm-app-1.0 --status CREATED_RUNNING_FINISHED_USER_CANCELED --keyword foo --sampling-method Window_Ratio --sort-by CreateTime_Status_TaskId_TaskName --sort-order ASC_DESC --region cn-hangzhou
